Same-game rule: legs normally come from different games. When only ONE game is on the slate or left, the ticket is built as a same-game parlay PREGAME.
All Sports parlay: safest 2-4 legs, about +100 to +115. Official.
safe100: BOTH TIERS [2026-10-25 10:30 AM user]: when a sport (or the Today/Big 4 bubble) has a qualifying 4%-tier combo AND a different qualifying 2%-tier combo, post BOTH as Official tickets, each with its own chip, own record rows and own grading. A 4%-tier combo has every leg at least 4%; a 2%-tier combo has every leg at least 2% and at least one leg under 4% (so it never repeats the 4% tier). The 2% ticket must differ from the 4% ticket by at least one leg, ideally every leg (player-disjoint tried first); the best such 2% combo by ticket EV posts. Max one ticket per tier per bubble. Otherwise the 9:44 AM rule stands: 4% first, 2% only as fallback. Locked tickets are never touched; a bubble whose ticket predates the tier rule may add a 4% ticket next to it. Players still never repeat across Safe tickets or POTDs. Data: the first ticket stays in the bot "sports"; the second-tier ticket goes in the "extra" list (extra:true, edge_tier, rec_tag). Record: its Parlay row Pick ends "(Edge 4%+)" or "(Edge 2%+)" and its Leg rows Prop "<SP> alt (Edge X%+)" / "Today alt (Edge X%+)"; rows without "(Edge" belong to the first ticket. Code: the bot (shared tier/sibling search) used by the bot (add_extras) and the bot (#n+1 skips tiers an open extra holds; a 4% #n+1 adds a distinct 2% sibling); the bot and the bot settle/price extras; index.html renders every ticket of the bubble.
Bans: MLB pitcher K props, MLB hitter unders, soccer, fantasy. One leg per player, one per game when possible. Never reuse a player from today's Safe tickets or any POTD.
One-game slate / one game left: same-game ticket allowed, built pregame. Priced by straight multiply (noted on card) unless a Hard Rock same-game parlay price exists.
Lock: locks on build. Re-runs never change a locked ticket.

Re-post: a lost ticket closes to Record and #n+1 builds from UNSTARTED same-day games only (kickoff > now+10 min), with the same leg rules. 2+ games are required unless only one unstarted game is left (then same-game is OK). Never the next day's slate.

Record: its own row, shown under Official as "Safe +100 (Alt Parlay)" on Results and Record. History restored from archive into Official. Each ticket counts once: a Safe +100 the user also placed is counted here only, at our posted price.

One per bubble: every sport tab has exactly one Safe +100 (alt) ticket, and the Today tab (Big 4) has exactly ONE Safe +100 ticket of its own, never a stack of every sport's ticket. EXCEPTION: a bubble may show two, one 4% edge version and one 2% edge version (EDGE FLOOR above), never more. Sport tabs show only their own ticket.

Today ticket: built from the Big 4 slate (NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB), unstarted games only, with the same leg rules as a sport ticket. It shows in both the Big 4 and All sports views, has its own record row filed under Big 4, and locks and re-posts like a sport ticket.
edge: Hard Rock price vs Pinnacle no-vig fair. Edge % = EV% at Hard Rock price. Ranked by edge %. Each pick is locked once posted.
ONE PASS, NO FILLER: Edge runs one pass and posts only plays that qualify. Nothing is filled. This supersedes COUNT's "at least 3" and ALWAYS FILL below.
Qualifying threshold: positive EV at the Hard Rock price, about -130 or better, Pinnacle prices both sides of the same line.

Grade: every Edge play shows a letter grade A..C on line 1 of its row, with the reason in its Why. Player props blend the edge % with a hit-rate model from real recent logs (last 10 + season); game lines and props with no log grade on price, max B+. Thin markets (alts, periods, 3-way) cap at B; fill plays below the bar cap at C+. Grades are display/strength only; ranking stays by edge %.

Display: Edge box collapsed shows only its play count until opened. Empty labels: "No Edge plays qualified today" when the slate has games and nothing qualified; "No games today" only when there are no games.
lotto: Official. Exempt from the official standards, same as The Heist: no 4% Pinnacle edge, no 2-leg cap and no -130..-250 leg range. Everything else still applies: real Hard Rock prices only (else a real price from another book, labeled Hard Rock unverified), never invent a price, locks, grading.

Scope: this formula and these selection rules apply ONLY to the TD City / Lotto Ticket (the NFL anytime-TD lotto parlay). They do not apply to POTD, Parlay +100, the All Sports parlay, Edge, The Heist, Alt Parlay / Safe +100, Cappers or any other ticket or pick, and they are not to be extended to other tickets by analogy.
Score each candidate and take the top 4-6 legs, preferring different games:
Prefer ≥2.5 RZ touches/game or a clear goal-line role.
Target real Hard Rock prices of about +150 to +450.
One per game (a 2nd only to reach 4), max 1 per team.
Skip any player with no red-zone usage in the last 5 games, regardless of name value.
Favor mobile QBs and goal-line RBs in high-total games.
Drop anyone listed questionable or worse at lock.

Display: NFL tab, one Lotto Ticket card (odds · legs · 🔒 Locked · stake in units (1u = standard stake unless the ticket has its own unit size) · status, ⭐ OFFICIAL badge), legs with Why, collapsed Notes. Weeks with no ticket show the empty Lotto Ticket card.

Record: shown under Official as "Lotto Ticket (TD City)" on Results and Record, ticket plus legs. History restored from archive. Each ticket counts once: a Lotto Ticket the user also placed is counted here only.
nascar: NASCAR: live race feed sits below Qualifying and loads collapsed. NASCAR/GOLF are non-majors.
grading: Picks are graded once the game is final. Ambiguous stays Pending.
Void = inactive/scratched player or postponed/cancelled game (no carry-over). Never void a POTD for price drift.
Parlay is L as soon as any leg loses. Runners-up removed mid-game are dropped, not graded.
results: Exactly three groups, in this order: Official, Edge and Cappers. Each shows its record broken down by prop type. Leg-by-leg records are not shown. Picks from dropped boxes and placed tickets are archived and never listed.

The Heist = the daily Cappers buy-downs, its own card and record under Official, tallied as individual alt props and graded nightly.

Record tab: the same groups in the same order (Official, Edge, Cappers), built from the same rows as Results, so both pages always agree.
Live plays (Live POTD, Live Parlay +100, in-game and live calls) are never tracked on Results or Record.
Count every ticket once. A leg that is the same play as that day's POTD counts once.
Units = 1u flat per pick: win +1, loss -1, push or void 0.
Sport filter chips: All, NFL, NHL, MLB, NBA, WNBA, NCAAF, NASCAR. Mixed-sport (Big 4) tickets show under All.

Money bag on hits, color-coded result chips, voided picks read "VOID".

heist: The Heist is a daily Official parlay built from the cappers' own picks, each bought down to a shorter real Hard Rock alt rung.

No lineup/injury rules: The Heist is strictly the cappers' plays converted down. Lineup and injury rules do not apply to it: no injury, inactive, matchup or lineup swaps on Heist legs, and "Questionable = out", Swaps, projected lineups, projected starters and replacements do not apply. A leg whose player does not play is settled under Grading below (void or DNP stays Pending until settled by hand).
Exempt from the official standards: no 4% Pinnacle edge, no 2-leg cap and no -130..-250 leg range. Everything else still applies: real Hard Rock prices only, never invent a price, locks, grading.
Cappers: at most one leg each from @alexcaruso, @panpotd, @austinsprops, @showtimepicks2, @bigmikepickz and @habibtings. Never @tonestakes, @doctorprofit or @salbets_.

Ticket: max 5 legs, one per game, at least 2 legs. With no ticket yet (before the first build, or fewer than 2 bought-down legs) the card is a minimal empty card: header, Stake 1u and this Rules dropdown, with no timing text.

TALLY = INDIVIDUAL ALT PROPS: every buy-down in the Buy-downs list is its own Official 1u single, graded at its converted Hard Rock alt line (the capper's original line when no rung was kept), priced at that Hard Rock alt price (kept line: the real Hard Rock exact-line price before kickoff, else the capper's posted price). Rows are written to the bot once the game starts (conversion frozen at kickoff) and graded nightly by the bot (W pays at the price, L = -1u, push/void 0; longest rush/rec from the ESPN box-score LONG column). Records shows THE HEIST group as per-prop W-L and units, by prop type and capper. Not graded (not a single prop with a gradable line): capper parlays, ML/side picks and ambiguous stats; the card lists each with its reason. The old parlay ticket record is archived in the bot (never deleted, never tallied). The card no longer shows a combined parlay price; it shows the day's alt-prop W-L and units. Every buy-down row and every leg shows the live prop tracker at the active book's converted line.

CAPPER SELF-AUDIT. The bot runs automatically, zero LLM, in every capper pull path: the 7 AM pull and every the bot run (7am, 10am, 1230pm, 4pm), in this order: the bot, then a pre-audit that fixes rows (result not gating), then the bot, then the bot, then the GATE audit against the freshly built the bot, then push. It does four things.
allofficial: Exactly three groups: Official, Edge, and Cappers (capper picks, tracking only). No other group, tier or label exists anywhere on the dashboard.

The official standards stay in force for every Official pick: Pinnacle no-vig price with at least 4% edge per leg, the morning prop scan only, parlays max 2 legs at -130..-250, NHL shot-over minimums, no fill. Exemptions: The Heist, Lotto Ticket / TD City and Safe +100 / Alt Parlay, each with its own rules in its section.

A former box that cannot meet the official standards is DROPPED, not converted: Runners-up, ALT LINES (sport and Big 4 cards), Home Field, NRFI and inning calls, Live POTD / Live Parlay, Live top lines, in-game lines and the NASCAR extra list. Their scripts no longer run from the bot.
Official history from before this order (POTD, Parlay +100, our recommended legs, Edge) is unchanged. No backfill, except the Lotto Ticket / TD City and Safe +100 / Alt Parlay history restored.

Strict readings: near-misses, fillers and model-only edges are not posted at all; Edge counts as Official, so Pinnacle 4% and NO FILL apply to Edge too; capper picks are idea sources tracked in Cappers only, never in the Official headline; live plays stay untracked; the NCAA F section keeps its separate record.
legday: What: a daily ranked Official board of up to 10 player props per sport at real Hard Rock prices -105 to -135, main or alt line. It replaces the old leg-by-leg Legs tracker.

Gates (every prop): at least 4% edge against the Pinnacle no-vig fair price. When Pinnacle has no price, the projection must be at least 8% past the line (LEG DAY only; it does not extend to any other ticket).
Source: only the morning prop scan, built on the full LineMate pull. No hand picks.
Role confirmed. Questionable players are out.
One prop per player, max 2 per game, no same-game stacks (every prop is its own single). NO FILL: if fewer qualify, post fewer; if none qualify, post none.
Ranking score: Edge 45, LineMate hit rate 25 (L5 weighted heaviest), matchup 15, role stability 10, news and line movement 5.
Board: numbered 1-10 by score. Stake: flat 1u per prop, shown in units only.
NFL: snap, target and rush share plus red-zone role. Healthy players post at the 7 AM ET publish; a player ruled inactive before kickoff is swapped.
NBA and WNBA: minutes and usage; usage bumps from injuries count positive; rest, back-to-backs and blowout risk count negative.
NCAAF: the NFL factors, stable depth charts only.
NASCAR: H2H or top-10/top-20 finish, using practice, qualifying and track history.
Holds: LEG DAY uses individual player holds only (a held prop holds alone; the board is not held as a whole).
Replacements: any replacement meets the same standard as the original pick.
Grading: nightly, each prop as a 1u single at its locked price; only final games are graded, never guessed.
